name: Wyoming State Cross Country Championships
where: Cheyenne, WY · Little America Golf Course
headline: Wyoming state: Madsen and Marney chase three-peats
summary: Cheyenne East's Maggie Madsen goes for a third straight 4A girls title on the Little America course, where she set the girls record of 18:17.63 last year, and Big Horn's Lyla Marney goes for a third straight 2A girls title. Powell's Karee Cooley (3A girls) and Burlington's Kellen Winters (2A boys) defend their crowns. The girls races start at 10:30 a.m. MT and the boys races at noon.
